appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Renewable Energy Production by Source'.
The vertical axis is labeled 'Reported production share (%)' and ranges from 0 to 70.
The horizontal axis lists five categories: 'Solar', 'Wind', 'Hydroelectric', 'Biomass', and 'Geothermal'.
The 'Solar' bar is yellow and has the value '41.2%' printed above it.
The 'Wind' bar is light blue and has the value '29.8%' printed above it.
The 'Hydroelectric' bar is blue and has the value '18.5%' printed above it.
The 'Biomass' bar is green and has the value '7.2%' printed above it.
The 'Geothermal' bar is brown and has the value '3.3%' printed above it.

public_definitions: The task requires identifying the largest renewable generation contribution source from the dashboard.
The largest contribution source is determined by the highest 'Reported production share (%)' value on the bar chart.
The identified source must then be routed to 'Escalated contribution review'.
The options provided are: 'Escalate Solar to contribution review', 'Escalate Wind to contribution review', and 'Keep Hydroelectric in routine source monitoring'.
